data.name: Assembly_Info_001
data.value: I'm s-sure you've wanted to have other Pokémon besides the two of you on adventures,[pause=10] right?

data.name: Assembly_Info_002
data.value: With my assembly,[pause=10] you can add or remove anyone you have recruited with Apricorns to your team for adventures!

data.name: Assembly_Info_003
data.value: Any team members you choose for an adventure will wait at the café for you!

data.name: Assembly_Info_004
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] you two will always be on the active team.[pause=0] You wouldn't want to miss out on any adventures,[pause=10] r-right?

data.name: Assembly_Info_005
data.value: Just know that sometimes only the two of you will be allowed on an adventure!

data.name: Assembly_Info_006
data.value: By the way,[pause=10] Pokémon names colored like [color=#00FF00]this[color] instead of [color=#00FFFF]this[color] are species you've already recruited!

data.name: Assembly_Info_007
data.value: Y-you can also view the list of Pokémon you can recruit on a dungeon floor!

data.name: Assembly_Info_008
data.value: Check Recruitment Search in the Others menu.[pause=0] If a species is [color=#FFFF00]yellow[color],[pause=10] that means they're already recruited!

data.name: Assembly_Info_009
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] one more thing![pause=0] You can also ring the signpost by the café to call me to use the assembly!

data.name: Assembly_Info_010
data.value: My e-ears are really sensitive,[pause=10] so I'll hear the bell and come running!

data.name: G2F1_001
data.value: Haha,[pause=10] I was stunned when I stepped inside the guild for the first time too!

data.name: G2F1_002
data.value: It's surprising to see so many Pokémon inside this tree,[pause=10] right?

data.name: G2F1_003
data.value: Greetings.[pause=0] As you may already know,[pause=10] my name is {0}.

data.name: G2F1_004
data.value: {0} informed me that two Pokémon were coming in who required me.[pause=0] That would be you two,[pause=10] correct?

data.name: G2F1_005
data.value: Y-yes![pause=0] That would be us!

data.name: G2F1_006
data.value: I see.[pause=0] What business do you have with the guild today?

data.name: G2F1_007
data.value: The t-two of us are here to...

data.name: G2F1_008
data.value: T-to...

data.name: G2F1_009
data.value: Um...

data.name: G2F1_010
data.value: (O-oh man,[pause=10] I'm t-too nervous to say anything...)

data.name: G2F1_011
data.value: Oh?[pause=0] You wish to apprentice here at the guild?

data.name: G2F1_012
data.value: Y-yes![pause=0] T-that's right!

data.name: G2F1_013
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] I believe I recall now.

data.name: G2F1_014
data.value: You have been here before,[pause=10] have you not?[pause=0] {0} was it?

data.name: G2F1_015
data.value: Y-yes sir...

data.name: G2F1_016
data.value: Ahh,[pause=10] I remember now.[pause=0] You applied here before,[pause=10] but you didn't have a partner.

data.name: G2F1_017
data.value: Looks like you have managed to find one though,[pause=10] hmm?

data.name: G2F1_018
data.value: What would your name be?

data.name: G2F1_019
data.value: Ah...[pause=0] So {0} is your name...

data.name: G2F1_020
data.value: A pleasure to make your acquaintance,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: G2F1_021
data.value: On to business...[pause=0] As it so happens,[pause=10] we have one opening for a team to apprentice at the guild.

data.name: G2F1_022
data.value: R-really!?

data.name: G2F1_023
data.value: Indeed.[pause=0] However,[pause=10] it is not up to me to decide.

data.name: G2F1_024
data.value: You would have to speak with the Guildmaster.[pause=0] He is the one who decides who may study here.

data.name: G2F1_025
data.value: Please let us speak with the Guildmaster then![pause=0] Please please please!

data.name: G2F1_026
data.value: Hmm...

data.name: G2F1_027
data.value: Very well.[pause=0] I will take you to see the Guildmaster.

data.name: G2F1_028
data.value: Y-you will!?

data.name: G2F1_029
data.value: Yes.[pause=0] Now,[pause=10] please follow behind me to the Guildmaster's office.

data.name: G2F1_030
data.value: I know you might want to look around town...

data.name: G2F1_031
data.value: But since we just joined,[pause=10] I don't think we should leave the tree tonight.

data.name: G2F1_032
data.value: Plus it's getting late...[pause=0] We should go to bed now actually.

data.name: G2F1_033
data.value: But we can look around a bit more if you want!

data.name: G2F1_034
data.value: Let's go look around the guild some more.[pause=0] I think there's more guildmates for us to meet!

data.name: G2F1_035
data.value: How is Team [color=#FFA5FF]Starlight[color] ever going to make a name for itself if you don't pick up the slack!

data.name: G2F1_036
data.value: Some teams,[pause=10] like ours,[pause=10] come here to find jobs posted on the boards.

data.name: G2F1_037
data.value: It's getting late and I wanna eeeeeaaatttt![pause=0] I'm starving!

data.name: G2F1_038
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] We're Team {0}![pause=0] We just joined the guild today!

data.name: G2F1_039
data.value: Hmm,[pause=10] OK.[pause=0] I was worried there was a local team I hadn't documented in my almanac.

data.name: G2F1_040
data.value: I didn't recognize your faces,[pause=10] so I thought maybe I missed a team.

data.name: G2F1_041
data.value: Wait,[pause=10] did you just say you signed up with the guild?

data.name: G2F1_042
data.value: That's right!

data.name: G2F1_043
data.value: Then that means we're guildmates![pause=0] I'm {0}![pause=0] I was the newest member at the guild before you two came along.

data.name: G2F1_044
data.value: This is great![pause=0] I finally have juniors that I can teach!

data.name: G2F1_045
data.value: I'll have to show you both my almanac,[pause=10] I bet you could learn a lot from it!

data.name: G2F1_046
data.value: Almanac?

data.name: G2F1_047
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] Everything I learn about adventuring I write down in my almanac![script=0]

data.name: G2F1_048
data.value: Adventuring teams,[pause=10] expedition discoveries,[pause=10] and dungeoneering techniques and knowledge!

data.name: G2F1_049
data.value: It's all in my almanac so that myself and others can all learn everything there is to know about adventuring!

data.name: G2F1_050
data.value: Wow,[pause=10] that's amazing!

data.name: G2F1_051
data.value: I bet me and {0} could learn a lot of useful stuff from something like that!

data.name: G2F1_052
data.value: When do you think we could look at your almanac?

data.name: G2F1_053
data.value: Anytime you want![pause=0] I'm always happy to share everything I've documented!

data.name: G2F1_054
data.value: But just so you know,[pause=10] there's actually a few books I write stuff in.

data.name: G2F1_055
data.value: It helps me keep the information more organized.[pause=0] Each book is for a different topic!

data.name: G2F1_056
data.value: Since I'm still kinda new,[pause=10] there isn't too much in them yet...

data.name: G2F1_057
data.value: But I add to them as I learn![pause=0] So I'm sure soon enough there'll be more pages than you can count!

data.name: G2F1_058
data.value: Anyway,[pause=10] I keep them in my room.[pause=0] Feel free to read through them anytime...[pause=0] Err...

data.name: G2F1_059
data.value: Hmm.[pause=0] I,[pause=10] um,[pause=10] never got your names.

data.name: G2F1_060
data.value: My name's {0},[pause=10] and my partner over there is {1}.

data.name: G2F1_061
data.value: {0} and {1}.[pause=0] OK,[pause=10] I'll have to make a note of that!

data.name: G2F1_062
data.value: I'm looking forward to learning and training at the guild here with you,[pause=10] Team {0}!

data.name: G2F1_063
data.value: We're all gonna learn how to be great adventurers![pause=0] I just know it!

data.name: G2F1_064
data.value: Hey {0}...[pause=0] It's getting pretty late...

data.name: G2F1_065
data.value: We should head back to our room and hit the hay for the night.

data.name: G2F1_066
data.value: Let's head there whenever you're ready,[pause=10] {0}.

data.value: We're all gonna learn how to be great adventurers![pause=0] I just know it!

data.name: G2F1_068
data.value: What do you want?[pause=0] Can't you see I'm doing something here?

data.name: G2F1_069
data.value: Wait,[pause=10] YOU guys were allowed into the guild?[pause=0] What a laugh!

data.name: G2F1_070
data.value: The Guildmaster's just letting anyone in,[pause=10] isn't he?

data.name: G2F1_071
data.value: Huh?

data.name: G2F1_072
data.value: I mean,[pause=10] look at you![pause=0] Total rookies![pause=0] Have you even done any adventuring?

data.name: G2F1_073
data.value: A little?[pause=0] Ha![pause=0] I knew it![pause=0] I could just tell that you're complete and total rookies!

data.name: G2F1_074
data.value: And that look on your face![pause=0] You're all flustered![pause=0] Hahaha!

data.name: G2F1_075
data.value: What's your deal?[pause=0] We just wanted to say hello to you!

data.name: G2F1_076
data.value: My DEAL is that I have no respect for a bunch of greenhorns like you!

data.name: G2F1_077
data.value: Especially when they waltz in here and bother me while I'm scouting outlaws![pause=0] It's unbelievable!

data.name: G2F1_078
data.value: Are you for real?[pause=0] What's unbelievable is how big a jerk you are!

data.name: G2F1_079
data.value: Is something the ma-a-a-atter, {0}?

data.name: G2F1_080
data.value: Wh-what?[pause=0] Uh,[pause=10] n-nope![pause=0] I was just having a conversation with the guild's newest recruits!

data.value: You're the new recruits?[pause=0] Hi hi hi![pause=0] It's grea-a-a-at to meet you![pause=0] My name's {0}!
